cast.name: Robo
cast.role: the lead: a young man who has just moved to Bratislava and takes the city one word at a time

cast.name: Zuzka
cast.role: Robo's neighbor in Petržalka; she shows him the city and keeps his Slovak honest

cast.name: Eva
cast.role: the barista at the café in the old town; she remembers everyone's order and everyone's business

cast.name: Tomáš
cast.role: Robo's colleague at the office; he explains the country over coffee and football

cast.name: Pán Ján
cast.role: the stallholder at the Miletičova market; grumpy until he is greeted properly

cast.name: Mária
cast.role: a doctor at the clinic; patient with learners, strict about rest

places.name: Eva's café in the old town
places.note: the café where Robo orders, reads and greets — the Speak café scene

places.name: Obchodná ulica
places.note: the shopping street where a stranger is asked the way — the Speak way scene

places.name: the office in the new building
places.note: where Robo works and meets Tomáš — the Speak colleague scene

places.name: the Miletičova market
places.note: the market where the shopping goes on — the Speak shop scene

places.name: Mária's clinic
places.note: where the sick go and rest is ordered — the Speak doctor scene

places.name: Zuzka's family flat in Petržalka
places.note: where lunches, parties and family talk happen — the Speak family scene

beats.hello: Robo arrives in Bratislava with two suitcases and meets Zuzka in the stairwell.
beats.cafe: Robo orders his first coffee alone; Eva saves him when the words run out.
beats.town: Robo gets lost looking for the main station and asks his way along Obchodná.
beats.family: Zuzka takes Robo to her family's Sunday lunch, where her mother asks more than his Slovak answers.
beats.everyday: Robo settles into a routine: up early, the tram to work, the shopping on the way home.
beats.yesterday: Robo tells Zuzka how his first week went, and what went wrong in it.
beats.health: Robo wakes with a sore throat and visits Mária, who orders rest in writing.
beats.shopping: Zuzka sends Robo to the Miletičova market for soup vegetables, where pán Ján quizzes him on the price.
beats.plans: Robo and Zuzka plan a weekend trip and argue with the weather forecast.
beats.moving: Robo rides the train to Košice for a match, muddles the platform change, still makes kick-off.
beats.people: Tomáš brings his brother to dinner and Robo has to describe everyone without mixing them up.
beats.work: Robo survives his first Slovak phone call at work and a meeting he understood half of.
beats.stories: Robo recounts the Košice trip at a team lunch, fixing the order of events while Zuzka winces.
beats.opinions: The office argues about a new tram line, and Robo gives his first real opinion in Slovak.
beats.offices: Robo sorts out a wrong delivery and a form at the foreigners' police office.
beats.world: A news item about a flooded Danube path gives Robo something to read and something to say at lunch.
beats.nuance: Robo writes to his landlord about a broken boiler and debates how much to soften the letter.
beats.register: At Zuzka's family table Robo hears the street version of every phrase he learned, and keeps them apart.
beats.media: Robo watches the evening news with Zuzka's family and follows it without the subtitles.
